newsitem.title: EGYPT: No Egypt cotton sales over holiday period.
newsitem.headline: No Egypt cotton sales over holiday period.

text.p: Egypt exported no cotton in the 15th week of this season because of the Christmas and New Year holidays, the Alexandria Cotton Exporters Association (Alcotexa) said on Monday.
"There were no new commitments," an Alcotexa official told Reuters of the week which ended on December 28. "We did expect this and it's normal."
In the first 14 weeks Egypt exported 61,440 tonnes. --Cairo newsroom+ 20 2 578 3290/1
